baseline: adc8a97 UI frozen before parking; same current core/native fixture in both variants
method: Three alternating fresh desktop pairs, five detached CDP post-diagnostic-GC samples per phase; medians within processes, then across three processes. No regression tests or other benchmarks run concurrently.
scope: Renderer isolate retained heap/DOM plus Linux Electron process-tree PSS/private pages for six synthetic 7500-line dirty TypeScript files, sampled after diagnostic renderer GC. Non-atomic process samples, not normal peak RAM, GPU/model memory or general speed. Dirty documents and undo states deliberately remain; the parked variant releases hidden view/plugin DOM.
